module.title: Helping it stick through the week

questions.text: In the coaching rubric, what does “Session Structure & Flow” look at?
options: The shape of the hour, from the opening to the closing prayer
How much the leader talks compared with the group
How many people speak, and how freely
The leader being honest about their own life
Linking the session to what people did between meetings
Giving others a part, so new leaders grow

questions.text: In the coaching rubric, what does “Newcomer Welcome” look at?

Anything shown that helps people follow the passage
Helping people carry a verse or an idea into the week
Praying together, beyond an opening formality
The shape of the hour, from the opening to the closing prayer
